tankCalibration.action: Menu > Water tank / set full > capture current distance > Save
tankCalibration.fullPoint: Software-defined valid ToF distance below 125 mm maps to 100%
tankCalibration.lowWarning: Existing distance threshold retained: above 125 mm maps to 9%, warning below 10%
tankCalibration.intermediateMapping: Linear from calibrated full point to 10% at 125 mm; differs from original stepped display

flushGuard.source: fresh hardware gross weight, independent of tare and scale display
flushGuard.homeStatus: Guard runs silently; blocked or stopped actions explain the reason
flushGuard.realMachine: No-tray raw offsets still require calibration. Do not copy the illustrative prototype calibration into firmware.
